pool.sol: Parallel to lines have slope \( -4 \). \( -5=-4(-7)+b \Rightarrow b=-33 \).

pool.text: For the linear function \( f(x) = ax + b \), the graph of \( y = f(x) \) has a \( y \)-intercept of \( (0, 3) \), and the graph of \( y = f(x + 2) \) has a \( y \)-intercept of \( (0, 11) \). What is the value of the constant \( a \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Since the \( y \)-intercept of \( f \) is 3, \( b = 3 \). Now \( f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3 \). The \( y \)-intercept of \( f(x+2) \) is \( 2a + 3 \). Given \( 2a + 3 = 11 \Rightarrow 2a = 8 \Rightarrow a = 4 \).
hints: Since the \( y \)-intercept of \( f \) is 3, \( b = 3 \).
Now \( f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3 \). The \( y \)-intercept of \( f(x+2) \) is \( 2a + 3 \).
Given \(2a + 3 = 11 \implies 2a = 8\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(x) = ax + b\) ، \(y = f(x)\) ، \(y\) ، \((0, 3)\) ، \(y = f(x + 2)\) ، \(y\) ، \((0, 11)\) ، \(a\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بما أن \(y\)-المقطع من \(f\) يساوي 3, \(b = 3\). Now \(f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3\). \(y\)-المقطع من \(f(x+2)\) يساوي \(2a + 3\). المعطى \(2a + 3 = 11 \Rightarrow 2a = 8 \Rightarrow a = 4\).
hints_ar: بما أن \(y\)-المقطع من \(f\) يساوي 3, \(b = 3\).
المعطى \(2a + 3 = 11 \implies 2a = 8\).

pool.text: What is the area of the triangle bounded by the lines \( y = 2x \), \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10 \), and the \( x \)-axis?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Find vertices: \( y = 2x \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (0, 0) \). \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10 \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (20, 0) \). Base along the x-axis has length 20. Intersection: \( 2x = -0.5x + 10 \implies 2.5x = 10 \implies x = 4 \). Height \( y = 2(4) = 8 \). Area \( = \dfrac{1}{2}(20)(8) = 80 \).
hints: Find vertices: \( y = 2x \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (0, 0) \).

Rewrite and simplify to obtain: \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10 \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (20, 0) \). Base along the x-axis has length 20. Intersection: \( 2x = -0.5x + 10 \implies 2.5x = 10 \implies x = 4 \). Height \(y = 2(4)\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y = 2x\) ، \(y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10\) ، \(x\)، أوجد القياس الهندسي المطلوب بدقة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y = 2x\) ، \(x\) ، \((0, 0)\) ، \(y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10\) ، \(x\) ، \((20, 0)\) ، \(2x = -0.5x + 10 \implies 2.5x = 10 \implies x = 4\) ، \(y = 2(4) = 8\) ، \(= \dfrac{1}{2}(20)(8) = 80\) والقيم العددية 20، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y = 2x\) ، \(x\) ، \((0, 0)\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

إرشاد منهجي (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10\) ، \(x\) ، \((20, 0)\) ، \(2x = -0.5x + 10 \implies 2.5x = 10 \implies x = 4\) ، \(y = 2(4)\) والقيم العددية 20 لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: A line has equation \( y = 3x - 7 \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of the line?

pool.sol: In slope-intercept form \( y = mx + b \), the \( y \)-intercept is given by \( b \). Here \( b = -7 \). At \( x = 0 \), \( y = 3(0) - 7 = -7 \).

الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y = mx + b\) ، \(y\) ، \(b\) ، \(b = -7\) ، \(x = 0\) ، \(y = 3(0) - 7 = -7\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: A two-digit number has a tens digit \( t \) and a units digit \( u \). The sum of the digits is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 greater than the original. What was the original number?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: \( t + u = 11 \) and \( (10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t = 3 \). Adding equations gives \( 2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t = 4 \). Original number is 47.
hints: Set up the initial relation: \( t + u = 11 \) and \((10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t\).
Adding equations gives \(2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(t\) ، \(u\) والقيم العددية 11 ، 27، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(t + u = 11\) ، \((10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t = 3\) ، \(2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t = 4\) والقيم العددية 47، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(t + u = 11\) ، \((10u + t) - (10t + u) = 27 \implies 9u - 9t = 27 \implies u - t\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(2u = 14 \implies u = 7, t\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: If \( \begin{cases} 3x - 4y = 7 \\ 2x + 3y = 16 \end{cases} \), what is the value of \( x^2 - y^2 \)?

pool.text: A barge travels 36 miles upstream in 4 hours and returns 36 miles downstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the current in miles per hour?

pool.sol: Let \( b \) be barge speed and \( c \) be current speed. Upstream: \( b - c = 36/4 = 9 \). Downstream: \( b + c = 36/2 = 18 \). Subtract first from second: \( 2c = 9 \implies c = 4.5 \) mph.

pool.text: For what value of \( k \) will the lines \( 3x - ky = 12 \) and \( 2x + 6y = 15 \) be perpendicular?

pool.sol: Slope of second line: \( 2x + 6y = 15 \implies y = -\dfrac{1}{3}x + 2.5 \implies m_2 = -\dfrac{1}{3} \). The perpendicular slope is \( m_1 = 3 \). First line: \( ky = 3x - 12 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{3}{k} \). Set \( \dfrac{3}{k} = 3 \implies k = 1 \).

pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(k\) ، \(3x - ky = 12\) ، \(2x + 6y = 15\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: الميل من الثاني المستقيم: \(2x + 6y = 15 \implies y = -\dfrac{1}{3}x + 2.5 \implies m_2 = -\dfrac{1}{3}\). العمودي الميل يساوي \(m_1 = 3\). الأول المستقيم: \(ky = 3x - 12 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{3}{k}\). Set \(\dfrac{3}{k} = 3 \implies k = 1\).

pool.text: If \( \dfrac{a}{b} = 2 \) and \( \dfrac{c}{b} = 5 \), what is the value of \( \dfrac{2a + 3c}{b} \)?

pool.sol: Split the numerator: \( \dfrac{2a + 3c}{b} = 2\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right) + 3\left(\dfrac{c}{b}\right) = 2(2) + 3(5) = 4 + 15 = 19 \).

Substitute and simplify: \(\dfrac{2a + 3c}{b} = 2(2) + 3(5)\).
Compute the final value from: \(4 + 15\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(\dfrac{2a + 3c}{b} = 2\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right) + 3\left(\dfrac{c}{b}\right) = 2(2) + 3(5) = 4 + 15 = 19\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

احسب النهائي قيمة من: \(4 + 15\).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the line \( 4x + 3y = 24 \) intersects the \( x \)-axis at point \( A \) and the \( y \)-axis at point \( B \). What is the length of segment \( AB \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( 4x = 24 \Rightarrow x = 6 \), so \( A = (6, 0) \). Setting \( x = 0 \): \( 3y = 24 \Rightarrow y = 8 \), so \( B = (0, 8) \). By the Pythagorean theorem, the distance is \( \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \).

pool.text: Line \( k \) passes through the points \( (7,2) \) and \( (-3,22) \). Line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \) and passes through \( (4,-3) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( p \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: The slope of line \( k \) is \( m_1 = \frac{22-2}{-3-7} = \frac{20}{-10} = -2 \). Because line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \), its slope is the negative reciprocal: \( m_2 = \frac{1}{2} \). Using point-slope form with \( (4, -3) \): \( y - (-3) = \frac{1}{2}(x - 4) \Rightarrow y + 3 = \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - 5 \). Therefore, the \( y \)-intercept of line \( p \) is \( -5 \).

Because line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \), its slope is the negative reciprocal: \( m_2 = \frac{1}{2} \). Using point-slope form with \( (4, -3) \): \( y - (-3) = \frac{1}{2}(x - 4) \Rightarrow y + 3 = \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - 5 \).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

pool.text: For what value of \( k \) does the system \( 3x - 6y = 12 \) and \( 2x - ky = 8 \) have infinitely many solutions?

pool.sol: For a linear system to have infinitely many solutions, the equations must be proportional. Notice that \( \dfrac{3}{2} \) is the ratio of the \( x \)-coefficients. For the constant terms, \( \dfrac{12}{8} = \dfrac{3}{2} \). Equating the ratio of the \( y \)-coefficients gives \( \dfrac{-6}{-k} = \dfrac{3}{2} \implies \dfrac{6}{k} = \dfrac{3}{2} \implies 3k = 12 \implies k = 4 \).

Equating the ratio of the \(y\)-coefficients gives \(\dfrac{-6}{-k} = \dfrac{3}{2} \implies \dfrac{6}{k} = \dfrac{3}{2} \implies 3k = 12\).

pool.text: In the system \( \dfrac{1}{2}x - \dfrac{1}{3}y = 4 \) and \( \dfrac{1}{4}x + \dfrac{1}{6}y = 5 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Clear fractions by multiplying the first equation by 6: \( 3x - 2y = 24 \). Multiply the second equation by 12: \( 3x + 2y = 60 \). Add the two equations: \( (3x - 2y) + (3x + 2y) = 24 + 60 \implies 6x = 84 \implies x = 14 \).
hints: Clear fractions by multiplying the first equation by 6: \( 3x - 2y = 24 \).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(3x - 2y = 24\) ، \(3x + 2y = 60\) ، \((3x - 2y) + (3x + 2y) = 24 + 60 \implies 6x = 84 \implies x = 14\) والقيم العددية 6 ، 12، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

اضرب الثاني المعادلة بواسطة 12: \(3x + 2y = 60\).
اجمع two المعادلات: \((3x - 2y) + (3x + 2y) = 24 + 60 \implies 6x = 84\).

pool.text: A line passes through \( (0, 4) \) and has a slope of \( -\dfrac{1}{2} \). What is the value of \( y \) when \( x = 8 \)?

pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: The equation of the line is \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 4 \). For \( x = 8 \): \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}(8) + 4 = -4 + 4 = 0 \).
hints: The equation of the line is \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 4 \).

pool.text: Line \( L \) in the \( xy \)-plane passes through \( (3, 8) \) and is perpendicular to the line with equation \( y = -\dfrac{1}{4}x + 2 \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( L \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Perpendicular lines have negative reciprocal slopes. The negative reciprocal of \( -\dfrac{1}{4} \) is 4, so line \( L \) has slope \( m = 4 \). Using point-slope form with \( (3, 8) \): \( y - 8 = 4(x - 3) \implies y - 8 = 4x - 12 \implies y = 4x - 4 \). Thus the \( y \)-intercept is \( -4 \).

pool.text: If the system of inequalities \( y \le 2x + 4 \) and \( y \ge -x + 1 \) intersects at point \( (h, k) \), what is the value of \( k \)?

pool.sol: The boundary lines intersect where \( 2x + 4 = -x + 1 \). Add \( x \): \( 3x + 4 = 1 \implies 3x = -3 \implies x = -1 \). Substitute \( x = -1 \) to find \( k \): \( k = 2(-1) + 4 = 2 \).

pool.sol: Linear transformation properties: \( E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5 \). The constant \( -5 \) does not affect spread, while multiplication by 3 scales standard deviation: \( \text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma = 3\sigma \).
hints: Linear transformation properties: \( E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5 \).
The constant \( -5 \) does not affect spread, while multiplication by 3 scales standard deviation: \(\text{SD}(3X - 5)\). Rewrite and substitute: \(\text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma\).
Confirm that probabilities lie in \([0, 1]\) and simplify any fraction or decimal to match the required precision.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5\) ، \(-5\) ، \(\text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma = 3\sigma\) والقيم العددية 3، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \([0, 1]\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: A manufacturer claims a machine produces parts with a mean thickness of 5.0 mm. A quality control inspector takes a random sample of 100 parts and finds a 95% confidence interval for the mean thickness of \( (5.02, 5.08) \) mm. What does this indicate about the manufacturer's claim?

choices: The inspector must take another sample.
The claim is not supported at the 95% confidence level because 5.0 falls outside the interval.
The machine definitely produces parts with mean 5.05 mm.
The claim is fully supported because 5.0 is close to the interval.
pool.sol: The hypothesized value 5.0 mm is outside the 95% confidence interval \( [5.02, 5.08] \), indicating statistically significant evidence that the true mean thickness is greater than 5.0 mm.

pool.text: Points \(P(-3, -4)\) and \(Q(5, 4)\) are plotted in the coordinate plane shown. If \(M(a, b)\) is the midpoint of segment \(\overline{PQ}\), what is \(a + b\)?

pool.sol: The line \( y = \frac{1}{2}x \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (0,0) \). The line \( y = -2x + 10 \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (5,0) \). Area \( = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 2 = 5 \).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the points \( (1, 3) \) and \( (7, 11) \) are the endpoints of a diameter of a circle. What is the equation of the tangent line to the circle at the point \( (7, 11) \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Center is \( \left(\frac{1+7}{2}, \frac{3+11}{2}\right) = (4, 7) \). Slope of radial segment from center to \( (7, 11) \) is \( \frac{11 - 7}{7 - 4} = \frac{4}{3} \). The tangent line is perpendicular to the radius, so its slope is \( -\frac{3}{4} \). Using point \( (7, 11) \): \( y - 11 = -\frac{3}{4}(x - 7) \Rightarrow 4y - 44 = -3x + 21 \Rightarrow 3x + 4y = 65 \).

\[ \begin{cases} 3x - 5y = 12 \\ 6x + ky = 7 \end{cases} \]

pool.sol: For a linear system to have no solution, the lines must be parallel (same slope) with different y-intercepts. The ratio of coefficients of x and y must be equal: \( \dfrac{6}{3} = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies 2 = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies k = -10 \). Since \( 7/12 \neq 2 \), there are no solutions.

pool.text: How many real solutions does the equation \( |2x - 6| = x - 5 \) have?

pool.sol: The absolute value \( |2x - 6| \geq 0 \) for all real \( x \). For \( x - 5 \geq 0 \implies x \geq 5 \). Case 1: \( 2x - 6 = x - 5 \implies x = 1 \) (not \( \geq 5 \)). Case 2: \( 2x - 6 = -(x - 5) = -x + 5 \implies 3x = 11 \implies x = 11/3 < 5 \). Neither candidate satisfies \( x \geq 5 \), so there are 0 real solutions.

pool.text: For what value of \( b \) does the line \( y = 3x + b \) pass through the intersection point of \( y = 2x + 1 \) and \( y = -x + 10 \)?

pool.text: In the system \( \begin{cases} 2x + py = 6 \\ qx - 6y = 12 \end{cases} \), there are infinitely many solutions. What is \( p + q \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Notice the constant terms: \( 12 = 2 \times 6 \). Therefore the second equation is twice the first: \( q = 2(2) = 4 \) and \( -6 = 2p \implies p = -3 \). Thus \( p + q = -3 + 4 = 1 \).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = 3x + b \) and \( f(f(1)) = 25 \), where \( b \) is a constant, what is the value of \( b \)?

pool.sol: \( f(1) = 3(1) + b = 3 + b \). Then \( f(f(1)) = f(3 + b) = 3(3 + b) + b = 9 + 3b + b = 9 + 4b \). Setting \( 9 + 4b = 25 \Rightarrow 4b = 16 \Rightarrow b = 4 \).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(1) = 3(1) + b = 3 + b\) ، \(f(f(1)) = f(3 + b) = 3(3 + b) + b = 9 + 3b + b = 9 + 4b\) ، \(9 + 4b = 25 \Rightarrow 4b = 16 \Rightarrow b = 4\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: The graph shows the volume of water \( V(t) \), in thousands of gallons, remaining in a municipal reservoir \( t \) hours after draining begins at a constant rate. According to the linear model, after how many hours will the reservoir be completely empty?

pool.sol: The constant rate of draining is \( m = \frac{15 - 24}{5 - 2} = \frac{-9}{3} = -3 \) thousand gallons per hour. Using point-slope form with \( (2, 24) \): \( V(t) - 24 = -3(t - 2) \Rightarrow V(t) = -3t + 30 \). The reservoir is completely empty when \( V(t) = 0 \): \( 0 = -3t + 30 \Rightarrow 3t = 30 \Rightarrow t = 10 \) hours.

The reservoir is completely empty when \(V(t) = 0\): \(0 = -3t + 30 \implies 3t = 30\) hours.

pool.text: A class of 20 students had a mean score of 80 on a test. One student's score of 95 was mistakenly recorded as 55. When the error is corrected, what is the new mean score?

pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: The error was an underestimate by \( 95 - 55 = 40 \) points. Distributing 40 points across 20 students adds \( 40 / 20 = 2 \) points to the mean: \( 80 + 2 = 82 \).
hints: The error was an underestimate by \( 95 - 55 = 40 \) points.
Distributing 40 points across 20 students adds \( 40 / 20 = 2 \) points to the mean.
Use the resulting form to finish: \(80 + 2\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(95 - 55 = 40\) ، \(40 / 20 = 2\) ، \(80 + 2 = 82\) والقيم العددية 40 ، 20، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: In the case where \( 4x + 7 = 31 \), what is the value of \( x \)?

pool.sol: Subtract 7 from both sides to isolate the variable term: \( 4x = 31 - 7 = 24 \). Divide both sides by 4: \( x = \dfrac{24}{4} = 6 \).
hints: Subtract 7 from both sides to isolate the variable term: \(4x = 31 - 7\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(4x = 31 - 7 = 24\) ، \(x = \dfrac{24}{4} = 6\) والقيم العددية 7 ، 4، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.sol: Subtract \( 2x \) from both sides: \( 3x - 12 = 15 \). Add 12 to both sides: \( 3x = 27 \). Divide by 3: \( x = 9 \).

pool.text: A system of two linear equations is given by \( 4x - 3y = 10 \) and \( 2x + y = 10 \). What is the value of \( x \)?

pool.sol: Multiply the second equation by 3 to eliminate \( y \): \( 6x + 3y = 30 \). Add this to \( 4x - 3y = 10 \): \( (4x - 3y) + (6x + 3y) = 10 + 30 \implies 10x = 40 \implies x = 4 \).

Add this to \( 4x - 3y = 10 \): \((4x - 3y) + (6x + 3y) = 10 + 30\). Rearrange and simplify to obtain: \(10x = 40\).
Solve \(10x = 40\) for \(x\) and verify your answer.

pool.text: If \( 5x - 3y = 18 \) and \( 2x + 7y = -1 \), what is the value of \( x - y \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Solve the system using elimination: multiply the first equation by 7 and the second equation by 3: \( 35x - 21y = 126 \) and \( 6x + 21y = -3 \). Adding the two equations eliminates \( y \): \( 41x = 123 \implies x = 3 \). Substitute \( x = 3 \) into the second equation: \( 2(3) + 7y = -1 \implies 6 + 7y = -1 \implies 7y = -7 \implies y = -1 \). Thus \( x - y = 3 - (-1) = 4 \).
hints: Solve the system using elimination: multiply the first equation by 7 and the second equation by 3: \( 35x - 21y = 126 \) and \( 6x + 21y = -3 \).
Adding the two equations eliminates \( y \): \( 41x = 123 \implies x = 3 \). Substitute \( x = 3 \) into the second equation: \(2(3) + 7y = -1 \implies 6 + 7y = -1 \implies 7y = -7 \implies y\).
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(5x - 3y = 18\) و \(2x + 7y = -1\), ما قيمة \(x - y\)?
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(35x - 21y = 126\) ، \(6x + 21y = -3\) ، \(y\) ، \(41x = 123 \implies x = 3\) ، \(x = 3\) ، \(2(3) + 7y = -1 \implies 6 + 7y = -1 \implies 7y = -7 \implies y = -1\) ، \(x - y = 3 - (-1) = 4\) والقيم العددية 7 ، 3، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(35x - 21y = 126\) ، \(6x + 21y = -3\) والقيم العددية 7 ، 3 لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(y\) ، \(41x = 123 \implies x = 3\) ، \(x = 3\) ، \(2(3) + 7y = -1 \implies 6 + 7y = -1 \implies 7y = -7 \implies y\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.sol: To find the \( x \)-intercept, set \( y = 0 \): \( 2x + 5(0) = 30 \implies 2x = 30 \implies x = 15 \). Thus \( a = 15 \).

pool.text: Function \( f \) is linear with \( f(0) = 8 \) and \( f(f(0)) = 0 \). What is the slope of \( f \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Since \( f(0) = 8 \), the expression \( f(f(0)) \) becomes \( f(8) = 0 \). Now we have two points on the line: \( (0, 8) \) and \( (8, 0) \). The slope is \( m = \dfrac{0 - 8}{8 - 0} = \dfrac{-8}{8} = -1 \).
hints: Since \( f(0) = 8 \), the expression \( f(f(0)) \) becomes \( f(8) = 0 \).
Now we have two points on the line: \( (0, 8) \) and \( (8, 0) \).
The slope is \(m = \dfrac{0 - 8}{8 - 0}\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(0) = 8\) ، \(f(f(0))\) ، \(f(8) = 0\) ، \((0, 8)\) ، \((8, 0)\) ، \(m = \dfrac{0 - 8}{8 - 0} = \dfrac{-8}{8} = -1\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(0) = 8\) ، \(f(f(0))\) ، \(f(8) = 0\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
إرشاد منهجي (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \((0, 8)\) ، \((8, 0)\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: If \( |x - 2| + |x - 8| = 6 \), which interval contains all solutions for \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: \( |x - 2| + |x - 8| \) represents the sum of distances from \( x \) to 2 and from \( x \) to 8. The distance between 2 and 8 is exactly 6. By the triangle inequality, this sum equals 6 for every point in the closed interval \( [2, 8] \).
hints: Set up the initial relation: \( |x - 2| + |x - 8| \) represents the sum of distances from \( x \) to 2 and from \( x \) to 8.
The distance between 2 and 8 is exactly 6.
By the triangle inequality, this sum equals 6 for every point in the closed interval \([2, 8]\).

pool.text: Which of the following inequalities is equivalent to \( 4x - 6y > 18 \)?

pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: \( -6y > -4x + 18 \). Dividing both sides by \( -6 \) reverses the inequality sign: \( y < \frac{-4}{-6}x + \frac{18}{-6} \Rightarrow y < \frac{2}{3}x - 3 \).

pool.text: A line is parallel to \( 3x - 4y = 8 \) and passes through the point \( (4, 1) \). What is the equation of this line?

pool.sol: Slope of \( 3x - 4y = 8 \) is \( m = \dfrac{3}{4} \). Using point-slope form: \( y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 4) \implies y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 3 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 2 \).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = ax + b \) with \( a > 0 \) and \( b < 0 \), which statement must be true about the \( x \)-intercept of \( f \)?

pool.sol: Setting \( f(x) = 0 \implies ax + b = 0 \implies x = -\dfrac{b}{a} \). Since \( b < 0 \), \( -b > 0 \). Since \( a > 0 \), \( -b/a > 0 \). Thus the x-intercept is strictly positive.

pool.text: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) is defined by \(2x - 3y = -5\). Line \(k\) is perpendicular to line \(\ell\) and passes through the point \((-4, 2)\). Calculate the \(y\)-coordinate of the \(y\)-intercept of line \(k\).
pool.sol: Rewriting \(2x - 3y = -5\) in slope-intercept form gives \(y = \frac{2}{3}x - \frac{-5}{3}\), so line \(\ell\) has slope \(\frac{2}{3}\). The perpendicular line \(k\) has negative reciprocal slope \(m_k = -\frac{3}{2}\). Using \((-4, 2)\): \(b_k = 2 - \left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)(-4) = 2 + (3)(-2) = -4\).

pool.text: Line \( k \) passes through \( (1, -1) \) and \( (3, 3) \). Line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \) and passes through the point \( (8, 3) \). At what point do lines \( k \) and \( p \) intersect?

pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Slope of \( k \) is \( \frac{3 - (-1)}{3 - 1} = \frac{4}{2} = 2 \). Equation of \( k \): \( y - 3 = 2(x - 3) \Rightarrow y = 2x - 3 \). Line \( p \) has slope \( -\frac{1}{2} \) and passes through \( (8, 3) \): \( y - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 8) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \). Setting them equal: \( 2x - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \Rightarrow \frac{5}{2}x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4 \). Then \( y = 2(4) - 3 = 5 \). The intersection is \( (4, 5) \).
hints: Equation of \( k \): \( y - 3 = 2(x - 3) \Rightarrow y = 2x - 3 \). Line \( p \) has slope \( -\frac{1}{2} \) and passes through \( (8, 3) \): \( y - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 8) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

pool.sol: From second equation, \( y = 2x - 8 \). Substitute into first: \( 3x + 2(2x - 8) = 19 \implies 7x - 16 = 19 \implies 7x = 35 \implies x = 5 \). Then \( y = 2(5) - 8 = 2 \). So \( x + y = 5 + 2 = 7 \).

pool.text: The line \( 2x - 3y = 6 \) is perpendicular to the line \( ax + 4y = 12 \). What is the value of \( a \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Slope of first line: \( 2x - 3y = 6 \implies y = \dfrac{2}{3}x - 2 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{2}{3} \). The perpendicular slope is \( m_2 = -\dfrac{3}{2} \). For \( ax + 4y = 12 \implies y = -\dfrac{a}{4}x + 3 \). Set \( -\dfrac{a}{4} = -\dfrac{3}{2} \implies a = 6 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(ax + 4y = 12\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(ax + 4y = 12\) and \(a\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(ax + 4y = 12\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(ax + 4y = 12\) و \(a\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: المستقيم \(2x - 3y = 6\) يساوي العمودي إلى المستقيم \(ax + 4y = 12\). ما قيمة \(a\)?
pool.sol_ar: الميل من الأول المستقيم: \(2x - 3y = 6 \implies y = \dfrac{2}{3}x - 2 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{2}{3}\). العمودي الميل يساوي \(m_2 = -\dfrac{3}{2}\). لـ \(ax + 4y = 12 \implies y = -\dfrac{a}{4}x + 3\). Set \(-\dfrac{a}{4} = -\dfrac{3}{2} \implies a = 6\).

pool.text:

\[ \begin{cases} 4x + 6y = 15 \\ 2x + ky = 7.5 \end{cases} \]

pool.sol: Multiplying the second equation by 2 gives \( 4x + 2ky = 15 \). For this to match \( 4x + 6y = 15 \), \( 2k = 6 \implies k = 3 \).
hints: Multiplying the second equation by 2 gives \( 4x + 2ky = 15 \).
For this to match \( 4x + 6y = 15 \),: \(2k = 6\). Rearrange the terms in \(2k = 6\) to isolate \(k\).

pool.text: What is the sum of the solutions to \( |x + 3| = |2x - 6| \)?

pool.sol: Case 1: \( x + 3 = 2x - 6 \implies x = 9 \). Case 2: \( x + 3 = -(2x - 6) = -2x + 6 \implies 3x = 3 \implies x = 1 \). Sum of solutions is \( 9 + 1 = 10 \).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(x + 3 = 2x - 6 \implies x = 9\) ، \(x + 3 = -(2x - 6) = -2x + 6 \implies 3x = 3 \implies x = 1\) ، \(9 + 1 = 10\) والقيم العددية 1 ، 2، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(x + 3 = -(2x - 6) = -2x + 6 \implies 3x = 3 \implies x\) والقيم العددية 2 لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
مجموع من الحلول يساوي \(9 + 1\).

pool.text: If \( 4x + 5y = 33 \) and \( 3x + 2y = 16 \), what is the value of \( x - y \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Subtract second equation from first: \( x + 3y = 17 \). Solve system: multiply second by 2: \( 6x + 4y = 32 \). Multiply first by 2: \( 8x + 10y = 66 \). Standard elimination: multiply first by 3: \( 12x + 15y = 99 \). Multiply second by 4: \( 12x + 8y = 64 \). Subtract: \( 7y = 35 \implies y = 5 \). Then \( 3x + 10 = 16 \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2 \). Therefore \( x - y = 2 - 5 = -3 \).
hints: Subtract second equation from first: \( x + 3y = 17 \).
Solve system: multiply second by 2: \( 6x + 4y = 32 \). Multiply first by 2: \( 8x + 10y = 66 \).
Therefore \(x - y = 2 - 5\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(x + 3y = 17\) ، \(6x + 4y = 32\) ، \(8x + 10y = 66\) ، \(12x + 15y = 99\) ، \(12x + 8y = 64\) ، \(7y = 35 \implies y = 5\) ، \(3x + 10 = 16 \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2\) ، \(x - y = 2 - 5 = -3\) والقيم العددية 2 ، 2 ، 3 ، 4، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: If \( f(x) \) is a linear function such that \( f(2) = 11 \) and \( f(5) = 26 \), what is \( f(8) \)?

hints: Since \( x \) increases by 3 from 5 to 8,: \(f(8) = f(5) + 3(5)\). Substitute and simplify: \(f(8) = 26 + 15\).
Compute the final value from: \(26 + 15\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(x)\) ، \(f(2) = 11\) ، \(f(5) = 26\) ، \(f(8)\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.

pool.text: A student needs at least an 85 average across 4 exams. If the first three scores are 82, 88, and 79, what is the minimum score required on the fourth exam?

pool.text: A high-speed train travels along a straight track at a constant rate of \( 90 \) kilometers per hour. What is the train's speed in meters per second?

pool.sol: \[ 90 \text{ km/h} = 90 \times \frac{1000 \text{ m}}{3600 \text{ s}} = 90 \times \frac{5}{18} = 25 \text{ m/s} \]

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, line \( L_1 \) has the equation \( 3x - 4y = 12 \). Line \( L_2 \) is perpendicular to \( L_1 \) and passes through the point \( (6, -1) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( L_2 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Rewrite \( L_1 \): \( y = \frac{3}{4}x - 3 \). The slope of \( L_1 \) is \( \frac{3}{4} \), so the perpendicular slope of \( L_2 \) is \( -\frac{4}{3} \). Using point-slope form with \( (6,-1) \): \( y - (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8 - 1 = -\frac{4}{3}x + 7 \). The \( y \)-intercept is \( 7 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(xy\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(xy\) and \(L_1\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(xy\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(xy\) و \(L_1\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(L_1\) ، \(y = \frac{3}{4}x - 3\) ، \(L_1\) ، \(\frac{3}{4}\) ، \(L_2\) ، \(-\frac{4}{3}\) ، \((6,-1)\) ، \(y - (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8 - 1 = -\frac{4}{3}x + 7\) ، \(y\) ، \(7\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: For a linear function \( f \), \( f(4) - f(1) = 15 \) and \( f(2) = 17 \). What is the value of \( f(0) \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: For a linear function \( f(x) = mx + b \), the rate of change is \( m = \frac{f(4) - f(1)}{4 - 1} = \frac{15}{3} = 5 \). Given \( f(2) = 17 \): \( 5(2) + b = 17 \Rightarrow 10 + b = 17 \Rightarrow b = 7 \). Thus, \( f(0) = b = 7 \).

Solve \(10 + b = 17\) for \(b\) and verify your answer.

pool.sol: Predicted score: \( y = 5.2(5) + 58 = 26 + 58 = 84 \). Residual \( = \text{actual} - \text{predicted} = 88 - 84 = +4 \).

pool.text: A line in the \( xy \)-plane has a slope of \( -\frac{5}{2} \) and passes through the points \( (c, 7) \) and \( (c + 4, d) \), where \( c \) and \( d \) are constants. What is the value of \( d \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Slope \( = \frac{d - 7}{(c + 4) - c} = \frac{d - 7}{4} = -\frac{5}{2} \). Cross-multiplying: \( 2(d - 7) = -20 \Rightarrow 2d - 14 = -20 \Rightarrow 2d = -6 \Rightarrow d = -3 \).
hints: Cross-multiplying: \(2(d - 7) = -20\). Simplify the relation to: \(2d - 14 = -20\).
Solve \(2d = -6\) to determine \(d\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(xy\) ، \(-\frac{5}{2}\) ، \((c, 7)\) ، \((c + 4, d)\) ، \(c\) ، \(d\) ، \(d\)، احسب معدل التغير أو الميل المطلوب.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(= \frac{d - 7}{(c + 4) - c} = \frac{d - 7}{4} = -\frac{5}{2}\) ، \(2(d - 7) = -20 \Rightarrow 2d - 14 = -20 \Rightarrow 2d = -6 \Rightarrow d = -3\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(2(d - 7) = -20\) ، \(2d - 14 = -20\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
حل \(2d = -6\) إلى حدّد \(d\).

pool.sol: Find the \( x \)-intercept of \( y = 2x - 6 \): \( 0 = 2x - 6 \Rightarrow 2x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 3 \). The intersection point is \( (3, 0) \). Since \( (3, 0) \) lies on \( y = mx + 4 \): \( 0 = m(3) + 4 \Rightarrow 3m = -4 \Rightarrow m = -\frac{4}{3} \).

pool.text: The line \( L_1 \) has equation \( 2x - 5y = 10 \). Line \( L_2 \) is the reflection of \( L_1 \) across the line \( y = x \). What is the slope of \( L_2 \)?

pool.sol: Reflecting across \( y = x \) swaps \( x \) and \( y \): \( 2y - 5x = 10 \implies 2y = 5x + 10 \implies y = \dfrac{5}{2}x + 5 \). The slope of \( L_2 \) is \( \dfrac{5}{2} \).

pool.sol: Copper from first metal: \( 0.30 \times 60 = 18 \text{ kg} \). Copper from second: \( 0.70 \times 40 = 28 \text{ kg} \). Total copper: \( 18 + 28 = 46 \text{ kg} \). Total alloy: 100 kg. Percentage \( = 46/100 = 46\% \).

Copper from second: \( 0.70 \times 40 = 28 \text{ kg} \). Total copper: \( 18 + 28 = 46 \text{ kg} \). Total alloy: 100 kg.
Percentage \(= 46/100\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(0.30 \times 60 = 18 \text{ kg}\) ، \(0.70 \times 40 = 28 \text{ kg}\) ، \(18 + 28 = 46 \text{ kg}\) ، \(= 46/100 = 46\%\) والقيم العددية 100، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: A line of best fit has equation \( \hat y = 3.5x + 12 \). If the residual for a point with \( x = 4 \) is \( -2 \), what is the actual \( y \)-value of this point?

pool.sol: Predicted: \( \hat y = 3.5(4) + 12 = 14 + 12 = 26 \). Residual \( = y - \hat y \implies -2 = y - 26 \implies y = 24 \).
hints: Start with: \(\text{Residual} = y - \hat y\). Rearrange and simplify to obtain: \(-2 = y - 26\).
Solve \(-2 = y - 26\) for \(y\) and verify your answer.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(\hat y = 3.5(4) + 12 = 14 + 12 = 26\) ، \(= y - \hat y \implies -2 = y - 26 \implies y = 24\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(\text{Residual} = y - \hat y\) ، \(-2 = y - 26\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(-2 = y - 26\) ، \(y\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: A class of \( 13 \) students has an average score of \( 85 \), and another class of \( 30 \) students has an average score of \( 85 \). What is the average score of all students combined?

تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(13\) و \(30\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.text: A commuter travels from City A to City B at an average speed of 60 miles per hour and returns along the same route at an average speed of 40 miles per hour. What is the commuter's average speed, in miles per hour, for the entire round trip?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Let the one-way distance be \( d \). Time going is \( d/60 \) and time returning is \( d/40 \). Total time: \( d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24 \). Average speed: \( \dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24 = 48 \text{ mph} \).
hints: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.
Let the one-way distance be \( d \). Time going is \( d/60 \) and time returning is \( d/40 \). Total time: \( d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24 \).
Average speed: \(\dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على القيم العددية 60 ، 40، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(d\) ، \(d/60\) ، \(d/40\) ، \(d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24\) ، \(\dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24 = 48 \text{ mph}\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(d\) ، \(d/60\) ، \(d/40\) ، \(d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
المتوسط السرعة: \(\dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24\).

pool.sol: Divide both sides of the equation directly by 3: \( 2x - 5 = \dfrac{27}{3} = 9 \). Note that the question asks for the value of the quantity \( 2x - 5 \), not \( x \).
hints: Divide both sides of the equation directly by 3: \(2x - 5\).

pool.text: A boutique sells bracelets for $18 each and necklaces for $32 each. In one week, the boutique sold a total of 45 items and made $1,090. How many necklaces were sold?

pool.sol: Let \( b \) be the number of bracelets and \( n \) be the number of necklaces. The system is: \( b + n = 45 \) and \( 18b + 32n = 1090 \). From the first equation, \( b = 45 - n \). Substitute into the second: \( 18(45 - n) + 32n = 1090 \implies 810 - 18n + 32n = 1090 \implies 810 + 14n = 1090 \implies 14n = 280 \implies n = 20 \).

pool.text: A plumber charges a fixed diagnostic fee plus an hourly rate. The total cost for a 2-hour job is $140, and the total cost for a 5-hour job is $275. What is the fixed diagnostic fee in dollars?

pool.sol: Let the cost function be \( C(h) = rh + F \), where \( r \) is the hourly rate and \( F \) is the fixed fee. The hourly rate is \( r = \dfrac{275 - 140}{5 - 2} = \dfrac{135}{3} = 45 \). Using the 2-hour job: \( 140 = 45(2) + F \implies 140 = 90 + F \implies F = 50 \).

pool.text: Line \( p \) has equation \( 3x - 4y = 12 \). Line \( q \) is parallel to line \( p \) and passes through the point \( (8, 1) \). What is the \( x \)-intercept of line \( q \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.

pool.sol: Rewrite line \( p \) in slope-intercept form: \( -4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 3 \), so its slope is \( \dfrac{3}{4} \). Since line \( q \) is parallel, its equation through \( (8, 1) \) is: \( y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 8) \implies y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 6 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 \). To find the \( x \)-intercept, set \( y = 0 \): \( \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 = 0 \implies \dfrac{3}{4}x = 5 \implies x = \dfrac{20}{3} \approx 6.67 \). (Accept 20/3 or 6.67).

pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(p\) ، \(3x - 4y = 12\) ، \(q\) ، \(p\) ، \((8, 1)\) ، \(x\) ، \(q\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(p\) ، \(-4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 3\) ، \(\dfrac{3}{4}\) ، \(q\) ، \((8, 1)\) ، \(y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 8) \implies y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 6 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5\) ، \(x\) ، \(y = 0\) ، \(\dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 = 0 \implies \dfrac{3}{4}x = 5 \implies x = \dfrac{20}{3} \approx 6.67\) والقيم العددية 20 ، 3 ، 6.67، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: The price of an item increased by 20%, and then the new price was discounted by 10%. If the original price was $50, what is the final price in dollars?

pool.sol: After the 20% increase: \( 50 \times (1 + 0.20) = 50 \times 1.20 = 60 \). After the 10% discount on $60: \( 60 \times (1 - 0.10) = 60 \times 0.90 = 54 \) dollars.

pool.text: A cyclist travels uphill for 12 miles at an average speed of 8 mph, and then returns downhill along the same 12-mile route at an average speed of 24 mph. What is the average speed, in mph, for the entire round trip?

pool.sol: Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Total distance: \( 12 + 12 = 24 \) miles. Time uphill: \( \dfrac{12}{8} = 1.5 \) hours. Time downhill: \( \dfrac{12}{24} = 0.5 \) hours. Total time: \( 1.5 + 0.5 = 2.0 \) hours. Average speed: \( \dfrac{24}{2} = 12 \) mph.

pool.text: A system of two linear equations has no solutions. One equation is \( y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2 \). Which could be the other equation?

pool.sol: Rewrite \( 3x + 4y = 12 \implies 4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 3 \). This line has the same slope \( -3/4 \) and a different y-intercept (3 vs 2), meaning they are parallel and have no solution. Choice D has \( y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2 \), which is the exact same line (infinitely many solutions).

pool.text: The line \( y = kx + 7 \) intersects the line \( y = -2x + 1 \) at a point with a positive \( x \)-coordinate and a positive \( y \)-coordinate. Which condition must \( k \) satisfy?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Set \( kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2} \). For \( x > 0 \), we must have \( k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2 \). Then \( y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2} \). For \( y > 0 \) when \( k + 2 < 0 \), the numerator \( k + 14 \) must also be negative: \( k + 14 < 0 \implies k < -14 \).
hints: Set \( kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2} \).
For \( x > 0 \), we must have \( k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2 \). Then \( y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2} \).
For \(y > 0\) when \(k + 2 < 0\), the numerator \(k + 14\) must also be negative: \(k + 14 < 0\).

pool.exam_archetype: Ratios, Rates, Proportions, Percentages & Scatterplots — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Initial almonds = \( 0.40 \times 500 = 200 \) g. Non-almonds = 300 g. For almonds to equal 50%, almonds must equal non-almonds (300 g). Therefore \( 300 - 200 = 100 \) g of almonds must be added.

Therefore \(300 - 200\) g of almonds must be added.

Take the negative reciprocal of line \(\ell\)'s slope to get the slope of perpendicular line \(k\).

pool.text: In the \(xy\)-plane, the points \((0, 0)\), \((3, -9)\), and \((6, k)\) are collinear. Calculate the exact value of \(k\).

pool.text: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) is defined by \(2x - 3y = 1\). Line \(k\) is perpendicular to line \(\ell\) and passes through the point \((4, -4)\). Determine the \(y\)-coordinate of the \(y\)-intercept of line \(k\).
pool.sol: Rewriting \(2x - 3y = 1\) in slope-intercept form gives \(y = \frac{2}{3}x - \frac{1}{3}\), so line \(\ell\) has slope \(\frac{2}{3}\). The perpendicular line \(k\) has negative reciprocal slope \(m_k = -\frac{3}{2}\). Using \((4, -4)\): \(b_k = -4 - \left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)(4) = -4 + (3)(2) = 2\).
hints: Solve \(2x - 3y = 1\) for \(y\) to identify the slope of line \(\ell\).

pool.text: The line \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to the parabola \( y = x^2 - 4x + 7 \). What is the value of \( k \)?

pool.sol: Set \( x^2 - 4x + 7 = 2x + k \implies x^2 - 6x + (7 - k) = 0 \). For tangency, the discriminant must be zero: \( (-6)^2 - 4(1)(7 - k) = 0 \implies 36 - 28 + 4k = 0 \implies 8 + 4k = 0 \implies k = -2 \).

pool.text: If \( \sqrt{2x + 7} = 5 \), what is the value of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Square both sides: \( 2x + 7 = 25 \implies 2x = 18 \implies x = 9 \). Checking: \( \sqrt{2(9) + 7} = \sqrt{25} = 5 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = 5\) to the requested unknown.

تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = 5\) و \(x\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = 5\), ما قيمة \(x\)?
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(2x + 7 = 25 \implies 2x = 18 \implies x = 9\) ، \(\sqrt{2(9) + 7} = \sqrt{25} = 5\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: A radioactive isotope decays at a rate of 12% per day. If a sample initially has a mass of 80 grams, which function gives the mass \( M(t) \) in grams remaining after \( t \) days?

pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Decaying at 12% means \( 100\% - 12\% = 88\% = 0.88 \) remains each day: \( M(t) = 80(0.88)^t \).
hints: Decaying at 12% means: \(100\% - 12\%\).
Rewrite and substitute: \(100\% - 12\% = 88\%\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(M(t)\) ، \(t\) والقيم العددية 12 ، 80، احسب معدل التغير أو الميل المطلوب.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(100\% - 12\% = 88\% = 0.88\) ، \(M(t) = 80(0.88)^t\) والقيم العددية 12، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.sol: \( \sqrt{2x + 15} = x \). Square both sides: \( 2x + 15 = x^2 \implies x^2 - 2x - 15 = 0 \implies (x - 5)(x + 3) = 0 \). At \( x = -3 \): \( \sqrt{9} = 3 \neq -3 \) (extraneous). At \( x = 5 \): \( \sqrt{25} = 5 \) (valid). The only valid solution is 5.

pool.sol: By Vieta's formulas, \( a + b = 7 \) and \( ab = 5 \). Using the algebraic identity \( (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \), we can isolate \( a^2 + b^2 \): \( a^2 + b^2 = (a + b)^2 - 2ab = (7)^2 - 2(5) = 49 - 10 = 39 \).

pool.text: If \( (x + 3) \) is a factor of the polynomial \( P(x) = 2x^3 + 5x^2 - 4x + c \), what is the value of \( c \)?

pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: By the Factor Theorem, if \( (x + 3) \) is a factor, then \( P(-3) = 0 \). Evaluate: \( 2(-3)^3 + 5(-3)^2 - 4(-3) + c = 0 \implies 2(-27) + 5(9) + 12 + c = 0 \implies -54 + 45 + 12 + c = 0 \implies 3 + c = 0 \implies c = -3 \).

Equation Setup: combine \((x + 3)\) and \(P(x) = 2x^3 + 5x^2 - 4x + c\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.

pool.sol_ar: بواسطة حلّل نظرية, إذا كان \((x + 3)\) يساوي a حلّل, فإن \(P(-3) = 0\). أوجد قيمة: \(2(-3)^3 + 5(-3)^2 - 4(-3) + c = 0 \implies 2(-27) + 5(9) + 12 + c = 0 \implies -54 + 45 + 12 + c = 0 \implies 3 + c = 0 \implies c = -3\).

pool.text: If \( \dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3} \) for all \( x \neq \pm 3 \), what is the value of \( A \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Multiply both sides by \( x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3) \): \( 4x + 11 = A(x + 3) + B(x - 3) \). To solve for \( A \), substitute \( x = 3 \): \( 4(3) + 11 = A(3 + 3) + B(0) \implies 12 + 11 = 6A \implies 23 = 6A \implies A = \dfrac{23}{6} \approx 3.83 \). (Accept 23/6 or 3.83).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) and \(x \neq \pm 3\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) و \(x \neq \pm 3\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) لكل \(x \neq \pm 3\), ما قيمة \(A\)?
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3)\) ، \(4x + 11 = A(x + 3) + B(x - 3)\) ، \(A\) ، \(x = 3\) ، \(4(3) + 11 = A(3 + 3) + B(0) \implies 12 + 11 = 6A \implies 23 = 6A \implies A = \dfrac{23}{6} \approx 3.83\) والقيم العددية 23 ، 6 ، 3.83، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: The graph of \( y = f(x) \) is shifted 3 units to the right and 5 units up to produce the graph of \( g(x) \). If \( f(x) = x^2 \), what is the value of \( g(7) \)?

pool.sol: By Vieta's formulas, \( r + s = -\dfrac{7}{2} \) and \( rs = -\dfrac{15}{2} \). Then \( r^2 + s^2 = (r + s)^2 - 2rs = \left(-\dfrac{7}{2}\right)^2 - 2\left(-\dfrac{15}{2}\right) = \dfrac{49}{4} + 15 = \dfrac{49 + 60}{4} = \dfrac{109}{4} \).

pool.text: For what value of \( a \) does the parabola \( y = ax^2 + 4x - 1 \) have its maximum value equal to 3?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: For a maximum, \( a < 0 \). The vertex occurs at \( x = -\dfrac{4}{2a} = -\dfrac{2}{a} \). Substitute: \( y = a\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right)^2 + 4\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right) - 1 = \dfrac{4}{a} - \dfrac{8}{a} - 1 = -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 \). Set \( -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 = 3 \implies -\dfrac{4}{a} = 4 \implies a = -1 \).

pool.text: If \( \dfrac{4x+1}{x-2} = A + \dfrac{B}{x-2} \) for all \( x \neq 2 \), what is the value of \( A + B \)?

pool.sol: Rewrite numerator: \( 4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9 \). Then \( \dfrac{4(x - 2) + 9}{x - 2} = 4 + \dfrac{9}{x - 2} \). Thus \( A = 4 \) and \( B = 9 \). The sum is \( A + B = 4 + 9 = 13 \).
hints: Rewrite numerator: \( 4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9 \).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9\) ، \(\dfrac{4(x - 2) + 9}{x - 2} = 4 + \dfrac{9}{x - 2}\) ، \(A = 4\) ، \(B = 9\) ، \(A + B = 4 + 9 = 13\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

مجموع يساوي \(A + B = 4 + 9\).

pool.text: If \( 2^{x+y} = 128 \) and \( 2^{x-y} = 8 \), what is the value of \( xy \)?

pool.sol: Write both right sides as powers of 2: \( 128 = 2^7 \) and \( 8 = 2^3 \). This gives the linear system: \( x + y = 7 \) and \( x - y = 3 \). Add the equations: \( 2x = 10 \implies x = 5 \). Subtract the equations: \( 2y = 4 \implies y = 2 \). Thus \( xy = 5 \times 2 = 10 \).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) passes through \( (0, 3) \), \( (1, 6) \), and \( (2, 13) \), what is the value of \( a \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: From \( (0, 3) \), \( c = 3 \). The remaining points give: \( a(1)^2 + b(1) + 3 = 6 \implies a + b = 3 \), and \( a(2)^2 + b(2) + 3 = 13 \implies 4a + 2b = 10 \implies 2a + b = 5 \). Subtract the first from the second: \( (2a + b) - (a + b) = 5 - 3 \implies a = 2 \).

pool.text: Which quadratic equation has roots \( 3 + 2\sqrt{2} \) and \( 3 - 2\sqrt{2} \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Sum of roots: \( (3 + 2\sqrt{2}) + (3 - 2\sqrt{2}) = 6 \). Product of roots: \( (3 + 2\sqrt{2})(3 - 2\sqrt{2}) = 3^2 - (2\sqrt{2})^2 = 9 - 8 = 1 \). The equation is \( x^2 - 6x + 1 = 0 \).

pool.sol: Cross multiply: \( 3(x - 1) = 2(x + 2) \implies 3x - 3 = 2x + 4 \implies x = 7 \).
hints: Cross multiply: \(3(x - 1) = 2(x + 2)\).

Solve \(3x - 3 = 2x + 4\) for \(x\) and verify your answer.

pool.text: If \( f(x) = x^2 + 2x \) and \( g(x) = x - 3 \), for what value of \( x \) does \( f(g(x)) = 0 \)?

pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: \( f(u) = u^2 + 2u = u(u + 2) = 0 \implies u = 0 \text{ or } u = -2 \). Since \( u = g(x) = x - 3 \): \( x - 3 = 0 \implies x = 3 \); and \( x - 3 = -2 \implies x = 1 \). The solutions are 1 and 3.

The solutions are 1 and 3.

hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(f(u) = u^2 + 2u = u(u + 2) = 0 \implies u = 0 \text{ or } u = -2\) لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.
بما أن \(u = g(x) = x - 3\): \(x - 3 = 0 \implies x = 3\). و \(x - 3 = -2 \implies x\).
الحلول تكون 1 و 3.

pool.text: The graph of \(f(x) = 2x^2 + (4)x + (-2)\) is shown in the \(xy\)-plane. Calculate the average rate of change of \(f\) on the interval \([1, 4]\).

pool.text: For all \(x > 0\), the expression \(\dfrac{\left(x^{\frac{4}{5}}\right)^{3}}{x^{\frac{2}{5}}}\) can be rewritten in the form \(x^k\). Which option gives the value of \(k\)?
pool.sol: Using laws of rational exponents (\((x^a)^b = x^{ab}\), \(x^a \cdot x^b = x^{a+b}\), and \(\frac{x^a}{x^b} = x^{a-b}\)), combining the exponents yields \(k = 2\).
hints: Convert any radical into a fractional exponent using \(\sqrt[n]{x^m} = x^{m/n}\).

Simplify the resulting rational exponent \(k\) to lowest terms.

pool.text: If \(f(x) = 3x + (-5)\) for all real numbers \(x\), what is the value of \(f^{-1}(13)\)?
pool.sol: By definition of the inverse function, \(f^{-1}(13) = x\) means \(f(x) = 13\): \(3x + (-5) = 13 \Rightarrow x = 6\).
hints: Use the equivalence \(f^{-1}(13) = x \iff f(x) = 13\).
Set the formula for \(f(x)\) equal to \(13\) and isolate the \(x\)-term.
Solve for \(x\) and check by plugging back into \(f\).

pool.sol_ar: من تعريف الدالة العكسية نضع \(3x + (-5) = 13\)، ومنه \(3x = 18\) أي \(x = 6\).
hints_ar: استعمل خاصية الدالة العكسية: \(f^{-1}(13) = x\) تكافئ \(f(x) = 13\).
ساوِ قاعدة الدالة \(f(x)\) بالعدد \(13\) واعزل حد المتغير \(x\).
أوجد قيمة \(x\) وتحقق بالتعويض في \(f\).

pool.text: Determine the remainder when the polynomial \(P(x) = 3x^3 + (2)x^2 + (-6)x + (1)\) is divided by \((x + 3)\).
pool.sol: By the Polynomial Remainder Theorem, the remainder upon division by \((x + 3)\) equals \(P(-3)\): \(P(-3) = 3(-3)^3 + (2)(-3)^2 + (-6)(-3) + (1) = -44\).
hints: Apply the Remainder Theorem: dividing \(P(x)\) by \((x + 3)\) leaves remainder \(P(-3)\).
Substitute \(x = -3\) into each term of \(P(x)\), paying careful attention to signs on powers of \(-3\).
Sum the resulting terms to obtain the remainder.
pool.text_ar: حدد باقي قسمة كثيرة الحدود \(P(x) = 3x^3 + (2)x^2 + (-6)x + (1)\) على \((x + 3)\).
hints_ar: طبّق نظرية الباقي: باقي قسمة \(P(x)\) على \((x + 3)\) يساوي \(P(-3)\).
عوّض \(x = -3\) في كل حد من حدود \(P(x)\) مع الانتباه لإشارات الأسس.
اجمع الحدود الناتجة للوصول إلى قيمة الباقي.

pool.text: A bacterial culture starts with \(400\) cells and increases by \(50\%\) every \(6\) hours. Calculate how many cells are in the culture after \(12\) hours.
pool.sol: Over \(12\) hours there are \(\frac{12}{6} = 2\) growth intervals, each multiplying by \(1 + \frac{50}{100} = \frac{3}{2}\). Thus \(N(12) = 400\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^{2} = 900\).
hints: Determine how many full growth or decay intervals occur during the total elapsed time.
Write the exponential model \(N(t) = N_0 \cdot r^k\), where \(k\) is the number of intervals.
Raise the multiplier \(r\) to the power \(k\) and multiply by the initial quantity.
pool.text_ar: تبدأ مزرعة بكتيرية بعدد \(400\) خلية وتزداد بنسبة \(50\%\) كل \(6\) ساعات. احسب كم عدد الخلايا في المزرعة بعد \(12\) ساعة.
pool.sol_ar: خلال \(12\) ساعة توجد \(\frac{12}{6} = 2\) فترات نمو، ومعامل النمو في كل فترة هو \(\frac{3}{2}\)، ومنه \(N(12) = 900\).
hints_ar: حدد عدد فترات النمو أو الاضمحلال الكاملة خلال الزمن الكلي المعطى.
اكتب النموذج الأسي \(N(t) = N_0 \cdot r^k\) حيث \(k\) عدد الفترات.
احسب \(r^k\) ثم اضرب الناتج في القيمة الابتدائية.

pool.text: If \( x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0 \), what is the product of all real solutions?

pool.sol: Let \( u = x^2 \): \( u^2 - 13u + 36 = 0 \implies (u - 4)(u - 9) = 0 \implies u = 4 \text{ or } u = 9 \). The real solutions are \( x = \pm 2 \) and \( x = \pm 3 \). The product is \( (2)(-2)(3)(-3) = -4 \times -9 = 36 \).

pool.text: A ball is thrown upward from ground level. Its height \( h \) in meters after \( t \) seconds is \( h(t) = -5t^2 + 30t \). For how many seconds is the ball at or above a height of 40 meters?

pool.sol: Set \( -5t^2 + 30t \geq 40 \implies -5t^2 + 30t - 40 \geq 0 \). Divide by \( -5 \): \( t^2 - 6t + 8 \leq 0 \implies (t - 2)(t - 4) \leq 0 \). The ball is at or above 40 meters for \( 2 \leq t \leq 4 \), which is a duration of \( 4 - 2 = 2 \) seconds.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(-5t^2 + 30t \geq 40 \implies -5t^2 + 30t - 40 \geq 0\) ، \(-5\) ، \(t^2 - 6t + 8 \leq 0 \implies (t - 2)(t - 4) \leq 0\) ، \(2 \leq t \leq 4\) ، \(4 - 2 = 2\) والقيم العددية 40، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: The line \( y = 3x - 5 \) intersects the parabola \( y = x^2 - 2x + 1 \) at points \( P \) and \( Q \). What is the \( x \)-coordinate of the midpoint of segment \( PQ \)?

pool.sol: Set equal: \( x^2 - 2x + 1 = 3x - 5 \implies x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 \). By Vieta's formulas, the sum of the x-coordinates is 5. The x-coordinate of the midpoint is the average: \( \dfrac{5}{2} = 2.5 \).
hints: Set equal: \( x^2 - 2x + 1 = 3x - 5 \implies x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 \).

The x-coordinate of the midpoint is the average to determine \(\dfrac{5}{2}\).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(x^2 - 2x + 1 = 3x - 5 \implies x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0\) ، \(\dfrac{5}{2} = 2.5\) والقيم العددية 5، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: Set متساوي: \(x^2 - 2x + 1 = 3x - 5 \implies x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0\).

x-الإحداثي من نقطة المنتصف يساوي المتوسط إلى حدّد \(\dfrac{5}{2}\).

pool.sol: Set the linear and quadratic equations equal to each other: \( x^2 + 6x + 7 = 2x + k \implies x^2 + 4x + (7 - k) = 0 \). pool.sol: Factor the numerator: \( \dfrac{(x - 4)(x + 4)}{x - 4} = x + 4 \) (for \( x \neq 4 \)). Setting \( x + 4 = 11 \) yields \( x = 7 \).

Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

pool.text: If \( \sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2 \), what is the real solution for \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Square both sides: \( 2x + 7 = (x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4 \). Rearrange into standard form: \( x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0 \). Factor: \( (x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = -3 \) or \( x = 1 \). Check for extraneous solutions: for \( x = -3 \), \( \sqrt{2(-3)+7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \neq -3 + 2 = -1 \) (extraneous). For \( x = 1 \), \( \sqrt{2(1)+7} = 3 = 1 + 2 = 3 \) (valid). Thus \( x = 1 \).

Equation Setup: combine \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2\) and \(x\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(2x + 7 = (x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\) ، \(x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0\) ، \((x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = -3\) ، \(x = 1\) ، \(x = -3\) ، \(\sqrt{2(-3)+7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \neq -3 + 2 = -1\) ، \(x = 1\) ، \(\sqrt{2(1)+7} = 3 = 1 + 2 = 3\) ، \(x = 1\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: A culture of bacteria doubles every 3 hours. If the culture initially contains 150 bacteria, how many bacteria will be present after 12 hours?

pool.sol: The number of doubling periods is \( \dfrac{12}{3} = 4 \). The population is modeled by \( P(t) = 150 \times 2^4 = 150 \times 16 = 2400 \).
hints: The number of doubling periods is \( \dfrac{12}{3} = 4 \).
The population is modeled by: \(P(t) = 150 \times 2^4\). Substitute and simplify: \(P(t) = 150 \times 16\).
Compute the final value from: \(150 \times 16\).

pool.text: Provided that \( 16^{3x} = 64^{x+2} \), what is the value of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Express both bases as powers of 4 (or 2): \( 16 = 4^2 \) and \( 64 = 4^3 \). Then \( (4^2)^{3x} = (4^3)^{x+2} \implies 4^{6x} = 4^{3x+6} \). Equate exponents: \( 6x = 3x + 6 \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2 \).

Equation Setup: rewrite \(x\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.

تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(x\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(16^{3x} = 64^{x+2}\) ، \(x\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(16 = 4^2\) ، \(64 = 4^3\) ، \((4^2)^{3x} = (4^3)^{x+2} \implies 4^{6x} = 4^{3x+6}\) ، \(6x = 3x + 6 \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2\) والقيم العددية 4 ، 2، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.

pool.text: If \( f(x - 2) = 3x^2 - 5x + 4 \), what is the value of \( f(3) \)?

pool.sol: To find \( f(3) \), set the argument equal to 3: \( x - 2 = 3 \implies x = 5 \). Substitute \( x = 5 \) into the expression: \( 3(5)^2 - 5(5) + 4 = 3(25) - 25 + 4 = 75 - 25 + 4 = 54 \).

Substitute \( x = 5 \) into the expression: \(3(5)^2 - 5(5) + 4 = 3(25) - 25 + 4\). Substitute and simplify: \(3(5)^2 - 5(5) + 4 = 75 - 25 + 4\).
Compute the final value from: \(75 - 25 + 4\).

pool.text: Examining the \( xy \)-plane, the line \( y = 2x - c \) and the parabola \( y = x^2 + 1 \) intersect at exactly one point, where \( c \) is a constant. What is the value of \( c \)?

pool.text: For what values of \( k \) does the equation \( x^2 + 4kx + (3k + 1) = 0 \) have no real solutions?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: No real solutions means discriminant \( D < 0 \). \( D = (4k)^2 - 4(1)(3k + 1) = 16k^2 - 12k - 4 < 0 \). Divide by 4: \( 4k^2 - 3k - 1 < 0 \implies (4k + 1)(k - 1) < 0 \). The roots are \( k = -1/4 \) and \( k = 1 \), so the inequality holds for \( -\dfrac{1}{4} < k < 1 \).
hints: No real solutions means discriminant \( D < 0 \).

Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

pool.text: If \( P(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 \) has a root at \( x = 1 \), what are the other two roots?

pool.sol: Divide \( P(x) \) by \( x - 1 \): \( x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 1)(x^2 - x - 6) \). Factor the quadratic: \( x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2) \). The remaining roots are \( x = 3 \) and \( x = -2 \).
hints: Factor the quadratic: \( x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2) \).
The remaining roots are \(x = 3\) and \(x\).
pool.text_ar: في مسألة رياضية ضمن (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(P(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6\) ، \(x = 1\)، أوجد القيمة الرياضية المطلوبة في أبسط صورة.
pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(P(x)\) ، \(x - 1\) ، \(x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 1)(x^2 - x - 6)\) ، \(x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2)\) ، \(x = 3\) ، \(x = -2\)، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: حلّل التربيعية: \(x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2)\).

pool.text: The graph of \(f(x) = -2x^2 + (-3)x + (-4)\) is shown in the \(xy\)-plane. Calculate the exact average rate of change of \(f\) on the interval \([0, 2]\).

pool.text: For what value of the constant \(k\) is the line \(y = -2\) tangent to the parabola \(y = 4x^2 + (-16)x + k\) in the \(xy\)-plane?
pool.sol: Tangency means \(4x^2 + (-16)x + (k - (-2)) = 0\) has exactly one real root, so its discriminant is zero: \((-16)^2 - 4(4)(k - (-2)) = 0 \Rightarrow 256 = 16(k - (-2)) \Rightarrow k = 14\).

pool.text: A \(192\)-gram sample of a radioactive isotope decays exponentially so that exactly \(12\) grams remain after \(20\) days. What is the value of the half-life (in days) of the isotope?
pool.sol: The remaining fraction is \(\frac{12}{192} = \frac{1}{16} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{4}\), meaning \(4\) half-lives occurred in \(20\) days; each half-life is \(\frac{20}{4} = 5\) days.

pool.text: For what value of the constant \(k\) is the line \(y = -2\) tangent to the parabola \(y = 3x^2 + (-18)x + k\) in the \(xy\)-plane?
pool.sol: Tangency means \(3x^2 + (-18)x + (k - (-2)) = 0\) has exactly one real root, so its discriminant is zero: \((-18)^2 - 4(3)(k - (-2)) = 0 \Rightarrow 324 = 12(k - (-2)) \Rightarrow k = 25\).
hints: Set \(3x^2 + (-18)x + k = -2\) and move all terms to one side.
For a horizontal line to be tangent to a parabola, the quadratic equation must have discriminant \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0\).
Solve the resulting linear equation for \(k\).

pool.sol_ar: شرط التماس هو أن يكون للمعادلة \(3x^2 + (-18)x + (k - (-2)) = 0\) جذر حقيقي مكرر أي \(\Delta = 0\): \((-18)^2 - 4(3)(k - (-2)) = 0\)، ومنه \(k = 25\).
hints_ar: ساوِ المعادلتين \(3x^2 + (-18)x + k = -2\) وانقل جميع الحدود إلى طرف واحد.
يتحقق التماس عندما يكون مميز المعادلة التربيعية مساوياً للصفر \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0\).
حل المعادلة الناتجة لإيجاد قيمة \(k\).

pool.text: Suppose \(125^{x + (-6)} = 5^{5x + (-24)}\) for a real number \(x\). What is the value of \(x\)?
pool.sol: Rewrite \(125 = 5^{3}\): \(5^{3(x + (-6))} = 5^{5x + (-24)}\). Equating exponents gives \(3x + (-18) = 5x + (-24) \Rightarrow (-2)x = -6 \Rightarrow x = 3\).

pool.text: A \(96\)-gram sample of a radioactive isotope decays exponentially so that exactly \(6\) grams remain after \(40\) days. Calculate the half-life (in days) of the isotope.
pool.sol: The remaining fraction is \(\frac{6}{96} = \frac{1}{16} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{4}\), meaning \(4\) half-lives occurred in \(40\) days; each half-life is \(\frac{40}{4} = 10\) days.

pool.sol_ar: نسبة المتبقي هي \(\frac{6}{96} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{4}\)، أي مرت \(4\) فترات عمر نصف خلال \(40\) يوماً، فيكون عمر النصف \(10\) أيام.

pool.text: For all \(x > 0\), the expression \(x^{\frac{3}{4}} \cdot \sqrt[4]{x}\) can be rewritten in the form \(x^k\). Find the exact numerical value of \(k\).
pool.sol: Using laws of rational exponents (\((x^a)^b = x^{ab}\), \(x^a \cdot x^b = x^{a+b}\), and \(\frac{x^a}{x^b} = x^{a-b}\)), combining the exponents yields \(k = 1\).
hints: Convert any radical into a fractional exponent using \(\sqrt[n]{x^m} = x^{m/n}\).

Simplify the resulting rational exponent \(k\) to lowest terms.

pool.sol_ar: باستعمال قوانين الأسس النسبية وجمع أو طرح الأسس للأساس المشترك \(x\)، نجد أن \(k = 1\).
hints_ar: حوّل أي جذر إلى أس نسبي باستعمال القاعدة \(\sqrt[n]{x^m} = x^{m/n}\).
طبّق قوانين الأسس في الضرب والقسمة وقوة القوة لتوحيد أس المتغير \(x\).
بسّط الكسر الناتج للأس \(k\) إلى أبسط صورة.

pool.text: A factory has two machines, M1 and M2, producing lightbulbs. M1 produces 60% of bulbs with a 2% defect rate. M2 produces 40% of bulbs with a 5% defect rate. If a randomly selected bulb is defective, what is the probability it was produced by M2?

pool.text: A medical test for a disease has a 95% sensitivity (true positive rate) and a 90% specificity (true negative rate). In a population of 10,000 people where 2% have the disease, what is the probability that a person who tests positive actually has the disease?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Disease: 2% of 10,000 = 200 people. True positives = \( 0.95 \times 200 = 190 \). No disease: 9,800 people. False positives = \( (1 - 0.90) \times 9,800 = 980 \). Total positives = \( 190 + 980 = 1,170 \). Probability = \( 190 / 1,170 \approx 0.162 = 16.2\% \).
hints: Disease: 2% of 10,000 = 200 people.

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق القوانين الرياضية المعتمدة في قسم (الرياضيات) بالاعتماد على العلاقات الرياضية \(0.95 \times 200 = 190\) ، \((1 - 0.90) \times 9,800 = 980\) ، \(190 + 980 = 1,170\) ، \(190 / 1,170 \approx 0.162 = 16.2\%\) والقيم العددية 2 ، 10000 ، 200 ، 9800، وبإجراء التبسيط الجبري والعددي خطوة بخطوة نصل إلى النتيجة الدقيقة المطلوبة.
hints_ar: إرشاد منهجي (الرياضيات): استعمل المعطيات الواردة بالاعتماد على القيم العددية 2 ، 10000 ، 200 لتكوين العلاقة الجبرية وتبسيطها خطوة بخطوة دون تسرع.

pool.text: A technician combines \(5\) liters of a \(15\%\) acid solution with \(20\) liters of a \(30\%\) acid solution. Find the exact numerical value of the percentage concentration of the resulting mixture.
pool.sol: Total pure acid is \(\frac{5(15) + 20(30)}{100}\) in \(25\) liters, giving concentration \(\frac{675}{25} = 27\%\).
hints: Set total pure solute equal to the sum of solutes contributed by each solution: \(c_1 V_1 + c_2 V_2 = c_f(V_1 + V_2)\).
Substitute the known concentrations and volumes into the conservation equation.
Isolate and simplify the unknown quantity.
pool.text_ar: خلط فني مختبر \(5\) لتراً من محلول حمضي تركيزه \(15\%\) مع \(20\) لتراً من محلول حمضي تركيزه \(30\%\). أوجد القيمة العددية الدقيقة للمقدار the percentage concentration of the resulting mixture.
pool.sol_ar: التركيز النهائي هو المتوسط المرجح بالحجم: \(\frac{5(15) + 20(30)}{5 + 20} = 27\%\).
hints_ar: ساوِ كمية المادة المذابة الكلية بمجموع كميتيها في المحلولين: \(c_1 V_1 + c_2 V_2 = c_f(V_1 + V_2)\).

pool.text: Printer X completes a batch job alone in \(36\) hours, and Printer Y completes the same job alone in \(18\) hours. Compute the value of the number of hours needed when both printers operate together.
pool.sol: Add unit rates: \(\frac{1}{36} + \frac{1}{18} = \frac{54}{648} = \frac{1}{12}\), so together they require \(12\) hours.
hints: Add rates of work \(\frac{1}{t_1} + \frac{1}{t_2} = \frac{1}{t_{\text{together}}}\), never times directly.
Combine the fractions over a common denominator.
Take the reciprocal to obtain the required time in hours.
pool.text_ar: تنجز الطابعة \(X\) مهمة طباعة بمفردها في \(36\) ساعة، وتنجز الطابعة \(Y\) المهمة نفسها بمفردها في \(18\) ساعة. احسب قيمة المقدار the number of hours needed when both printers operate together.
pool.sol_ar: بجمع معدلي الإنجاز: \(\frac{1}{36} + \frac{1}{18} = \frac{1}{12}\)، فيكون الزمن المشترك \(12\) ساعة.
hints_ar: اجمع معدلات العمل \(\frac{1}{t_1} + \frac{1}{t_2} = \frac{1}{t_{\text{معاً}}}\) ولا تجمع الأزمنة مباشرة.
وحّد المقامات وبسّط الكسر الناتج.
خذ المقلوب لإيجاد الزمن المطلوب بالساعات.
